allocation_rules_kind_values_check.name: allocation_rules_kind_values_check

corporate_actions_kind_values_check.name: corporate_actions_kind_values_check

goal_allocation_events_shape_check.name: goal_allocation_events_shape_check

goal_allocations_shape_check.name: goal_allocations_shape_check
goal_allocations_shape_check.value:
(
        "goal_allocations"."account_id" is not null and "goal_allocations"."amount" is not null and "goal_allocations"."amount" > 0
          and "goal_allocations"."holding_id" is null and "goal_allocations"."percent" is null
      ) or (
        "goal_allocations"."holding_id" is not null and "goal_allocations"."percent" is not null and "goal_allocations"."percent" > 0 and "goal_allocations"."percent" <= 1
          and "goal_allocations"."account_id" is null and "goal_allocations"."amount" is null
      )

holdings_gold_fields_check.name: holdings_gold_fields_check
holdings_gold_fields_check.value:
("holdings"."kind"::text = 'gold' and "holdings"."karat" in (24, 21, 18) and "holdings"."form" is not null)
        or ("holdings"."kind"::text <> 'gold' and "holdings"."karat" is null and "holdings"."form" is null)

holdings_cloud_fields_check.name: holdings_cloud_fields_check
holdings_cloud_fields_check.value:
"holdings"."kind"::text = 'cloud' or (
        "holdings"."start_date" is null and "holdings"."maturity_date" is null
        and "holdings"."contribution_amount" is null and "holdings"."contribution_frequency" is null
      )

holdings_cloud_values_check.name: holdings_cloud_values_check
holdings_cloud_values_check.value:
("holdings"."maturity_date" is null or "holdings"."start_date" is null or "holdings"."maturity_date" >= "holdings"."start_date")
        and ("holdings"."contribution_amount" is null) = ("holdings"."contribution_frequency" is null)
        and ("holdings"."contribution_amount" is null or "holdings"."contribution_amount" > 0)

transactions_accounts_by_type_check.name: transactions_accounts_by_type_check
transactions_accounts_by_type_check.value:
(
        "transactions"."type" in ('INCOME', 'DIVIDEND', 'INTEREST', 'INVESTMENT_SALE', 'ADJUSTMENT')
          and "transactions"."to_account_id" is not null and "transactions"."from_account_id" is null
      ) or (
        "transactions"."type" in ('EXPENSE', 'INVESTMENT_PURCHASE', 'LIABILITY_PAYMENT')
          and "transactions"."from_account_id" is not null and "transactions"."to_account_id" is null
      ) or (
        "transactions"."type" = 'TRANSFER'
          and "transactions"."from_account_id" is not null and "transactions"."to_account_id" is not null
          and "transactions"."from_account_id" <> "transactions"."to_account_id"
      )

transactions_quantity_price_check.name: transactions_quantity_price_check
